The good case: the shipped privacy-manifest.ts template under tests/bases/pods (a prebuilt ios/ folder: two trunk pods, two development pods, the prebuilt app manifest). The two trunk pod manifests are verbatim copies of Google-Mobile-Ads-SDK 13.6.0 and GoogleUserMessagingPlatform 3.1.0 from a real SDK 57 prebuild (2026-10-14): no NSPrivacyTracking key, no tracking domains, Device ID collected for tracking. Cases that need tracking keys or domains plant them.
